# Sale Solution

> Revenue systems for businesses that sell parts, book jobs, and fill chairs. We get industrial e-commerce sites cited in AI answers, and we run a done-for-you system that books the calls local-service businesses miss.

Sale Solution runs two motions. For industrial and technical-distribution e-commerce, we restructure catalogs and content so AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity cite them — the places high-intent B2B buyers now research before they buy. For local-service businesses, the Revenue Engine answers every call, replies in seconds, books the job, chases the quotes that stall, and proves the revenue. We publish primary research, frameworks, a glossary, and case studies on how to make commerce content extractable, citable, and trustworthy enough to be quoted by generative-search engines. Citations welcome — please link back to the source URL.

## Services (industrial & technical-distribution e-commerce)

- [AI SEO / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://salesolution.net/services/ai-seo/): Restructure category and product pages so AI Overviews and LLM answer engines cite them.
- [Catalog AI](https://salesolution.net/services/catalog-ai/): Product-level schema, attribute normalization, and internal linking at SKU scale so the catalog is retrievable by AI search.
- [Editorial Authority](https://salesolution.net/services/editorial-authority/): Pillar pages and evidence-backed content that build the citation authority AI engines reward.
- [Website Development & Design](https://salesolution.net/services/website-development-design-services/): Performance + schema-first site builds.
- [Outbound Email Marketing](https://salesolution.net/services/outbound-email-marketing-services/): Deliverability-first outbound for B2B distributors.
- [Full Growth Ownership](https://salesolution.net/services/full-growth-ownership/): One senior operator owning SEO, GEO, content, and conversion end to end.

## Revenue Engine (local-service businesses)

A productized, done-for-you monthly system for businesses that run on calls and bookings — roofing and home services, dental, medical, local retail. It captures every lead, responds in seconds, books the job, recovers cold quotes, and proves the revenue (CAPTURE → RESPOND → BOOK → RECOVER → PROVE).

- [Revenue Engine](https://salesolution.net/revenue-engine/): How the system captures, responds, books, recovers, and proves — with the revenue-leak math. Book a Revenue Leak Audit here.
- [Home services & roofing](https://salesolution.net/revenue-engine/home-services/): Answer every call, reply in seconds, and chase the quotes that go cold.
- [Dental practices](https://salesolution.net/revenue-engine/dentists/): Capture new-patient calls and book them before they ring the next office.
- [Medical & aesthetic practices](https://salesolution.net/revenue-engine/medical/): Capture and book consults without adding front-desk headcount.
- [Local retail](https://salesolution.net/revenue-engine/local-retail/): Turn calls and quote requests into booked, paid work.

## Learning hub

- [AI-search glossary](https://salesolution.net/glossary/): Plain-English definitions of AI-search, GEO, and answer-engine terms. Built for industrial e-commerce, home-services, and dental teams. Browse the hub for every current definition.
- [Career paths](https://salesolution.net/career-paths/): The roles of modern AI search, taught as numbered skill modules by seniority (entry to senior), with examples across industrial e-commerce, home services, and dental.
- [AI-search role map (JSON)](https://salesolution.net/career-paths/roles-map/): The career paths as machine-readable data — skill modules by seniority plus the prerequisite and next-step graph. CC BY 4.0; reuse with a link back.
